column1: # Tachyon sidecar — canonical local/parameter variable names.
#   kind     : param | local  (informational; matching is by storage then pc)
#   storage  : VariableStorage key, e.g. Stack[-0x8]:4 or EAX:4  (the match key)
#   pc       : symbol PC address hex, or - if none (disambiguates reused register storage)
#   datatype : optional; applied only if resolvable, else existing type is left unchanged
# Source of truth for variable naming. Apply with ApplyVars.java, then re-run ExportCorpus.java.
# Back-port GUI edits with DumpVars.java -> vars.export.tsv, then merge the rows you want here.
